blocks.text:
Here is a simple example with translatable strings in C++ code. It shows what
you can do if you don't use autotools or `meson`.
It is also an example of using the `Gtk::TextView` widget.
blocks.zh: 这是一个在 C++ 代码里带有可翻译字符串的简单示例，展示了不使用 autotools 或 `meson` 时可以怎么做。它同时也是使用 `Gtk::TextView` 部件的示例。

blocks.text:
This program can set the locale, if it's specified in a configuration file.
This is not normal behavior. Most programs accept the locale that the user
has selected, for instance with an environment variable.
blocks.zh: 这个程序可以设置区域，如果配置文件里指定了的话。这不是常规做法，大多数程序采用用户已选定的区域，例如通过环境变量。
